name: cadre-lifecycle-gitlab
description: GitLab-flavored Agentic SDLC gate governance: lifecycle-review-gitlab records gate decisions from a real GitLab MR approval; gitlab-gate-tracking publishes GitLab tracking issues for a task's gates and assigns linked approval-subtask issues to each gate's authority; link-source-issue-gitlab records a real GitLab issue as the recorded source for a task's G1 (Intent) or G2 (Requirements Baseline) gate; publish-gate-status-gitlab posts (and idempotently updates) a one-way, read-only gate-status summary note on a task's GitLab MR; report-gate-reviewers-gitlab reports (read-only, never sets) which GitLab usernames would be set as MR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates. Bundles its own onboarding, generic gate-decision, pending-gates briefing, and kernel bootstrap skills (lifecycle-onboarding-gitlab, lifecycle-review-generic-gitlab, brief-pending-gates-gitlab), so cadre-lifecycle-core is optional -- only needed for forge-agnostic-only use elsewhere. Requires a recent-enough agentic-sdlc kernel.

interface.shortDescription: Record Agentic SDLC gate decisions and publish gate/approval tracking issues in GitLab.
interface.longDescription: Conversationally record a lifecycle gate decision sourced from an actual GitLab merge request approval, publish GitLab tracking issues for a task's gates with linked approval subtasks assigned to each gate's authority, record a real GitLab issue as the recorded source for a task's G1 (Intent) or G2 (Requirements Baseline) gate, post (and idempotently update) a one-way, read-only gate-status summary note on a task's GitLab MR, or report (read-only, never sets) which GitLab usernames would be set as MR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates. Bundles its own onboarding, generic gate-decision, and pending-gates briefing skills plus kernel bootstrap -- cadre-lifecycle-core is optional.
defaultPrompt: Use lifecycle-onboarding-gitlab to set up Agentic SDLC lifecycle tracking for this project.
Use lifecycle-review-gitlab to record a gate decision from a GitLab MR approval.
Use lifecycle-review-generic-gitlab to record a gate decision when there's no GitLab approval to cite.
Use brief-pending-gates-gitlab for a local-only briefing of pending gates and who needs to sign off.
Use gitlab-gate-tracking to publish GitLab issues for this task's gates and approvals.
Use link-source-issue-gitlab to record a GitLab issue as the source for a task's G1 or G2 gate.
Use publish-gate-status-gitlab to post or refresh a one-way, read-only gate-status summary note on this task's GitLab MR.
Use report-gate-reviewers-gitlab to see which GitLab usernames would be set as MR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates (read-only, never sets).

kernelInstall.title: Kernel install mode
kernelInstall.description: How to obtain the Agentic SDLC kernel. 'auto' (default) lets this plugin install and manage its own copy under its data directory. 'system' uses only a kernel you installed yourself and never installs anything. 'off' disables the check entirely -- set AGENTIC_SDLC_BIN yourself. Unrecognized values are treated as 'auto'.

profile.title: Provider profile
profile.description: Provider profile id passed to `agentic-sdlc init`, e.g. secure-cloud. Leave blank for kernel-only lifecycle operation with no profile.
